pages.text: $(bold)What it does:$(0) freezes "flowing" Life Energy into portable $(4)Life Essence Solids$(0).$(br2)$(bold)Recipe:$(0) $(4)10M Akaishi Energy + 1000 Life Energy$(0) → 1 Solid, about 10 ticks per run (draws up to 1M akaishi/tick).$(br2)$(bold)Interfaces:$(0) akaishi buffer of 20M (expandable with energy upgrades), Life Energy buffer of 5,000 (enough for 5 runs); the output slot accepts hoppers and item pipes for full automation.

pages.title: Solids = Universal Currency
pages.text: Solids are the life line's $(4)universal currency$(0) — $(bold)stockpile before you build$(0):$(li)Life Structuring Table: $(4)5$(0) per organ$(li)Surgery Chamber implant: $(4)3$(0) per operation (extraction: 1)$(li)Cultivator purification / tier upgrade: $(4)1-16$(0) by tier$(li)Potion Table: $(4)3$(0) permanent / $(4)5$(0) breakthrough$(li)Embryo recipe: $(4)8$(0) around 1 egg → 1 Life Embryo$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$(0) run your Matrix output into the Purifier first — bank the energy, then start researching.
Where the feedstock comes from and goes: "$(l:akaishi:life_energy)Life Energy$(/l)" and "$(l:akaishi:life_conversion)Life Conversion$(/l)"; once you've banked enough, open the sample line.
